en.title: Global Macro — Japan's price rebound, euro-area debt and US mortgage costs expose divergent refinancing pressures
en.deck: New Japanese September inflation shows 2.1% headline and 2.4% excluding fresh food and energy; euro-area quarterly debt reaches 88.8% of GDP and the US 30-year mortgage rate remains high at 7.32%.
en.regime: Heterogeneous consumer-price persistence, sovereign refinancing risks and high household borrowing costs across major regions.
en.key_risk: Funding costs and inflation expectations tighten household and fiscal room before any synchronized drop in measured GDP.

pt-BR.title: Macro Global — inflação no Japão, dívida na área do euro e financiamento imobiliário nos EUA revelam pressões diferentes de refinanciamento

pt-BR.regime: Persistência inflacionária heterogênea, riscos de refinanciamento soberano e juros elevados para famílias em grandes regiões.
